propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage (_usage dict) in the LLM runner but never emits these counts to CloudWatch, leaving token consumption invisible and non-billable.

The finalize.py metrics assembler reads _usage only for verify request counts and ignores token fields; voter.py never reads _usage at all despite having an established boto3 error-publishing pattern.

The bot must aggregate input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens from Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps into coverage.metrics for both CloudWatch emission and artifact persistence.

Token metrics must be published to CloudWatch as best-effort (swallowing any boto3 import/credential/network errors without failing the vote) with a fallback journald marker for reliable host observability.

Pass-1 finder token usage is explicitly deferred (not surfaced on step outputs and requires shared plan-review signature changes); a follow-up ticket captures the remaining coverage gap to achieve complete token visibility.
